works.author: SlabPixel Designer
works.comment: AI 简报撰写助手 Nexora：深绿色产品展示页，手机屏里是“Frequently Asked Questions”，主文案“From a gap to a ready brief, on its own”，右侧闪电图标的 AI 仪表盘收着生成进度；AI 工具页用“一部手机 + 一块仪表盘”把“缺口到成稿、全程自动”讲得干净利落。
works.comment_en: Nexora's Brief Writer Agent: a deep-green showcase page puts "Frequently Asked Questions" on a phone screen under "From a gap to a ready brief, on its own", with a lightning-marked AI dashboard tracking progress beside it; gap-to-brief, fully on its own, told cleanly with one phone and one dashboard.
works.title: Brief Writer Agent (Product Showcase Page) - Nexora AI

works.author: Fahema Yesmin
works.comment: 定制商品电商站 Brand Surge：多张纵向网页长截图拼成客户项目回顾，紫蓝配色贯穿始终，主文案“Promotional products that perform”，背包、帽子等定制商品轮番出镜；电商案例页用“一叠长截图 + 一句效果承诺”把定制商品的卖点一次摊开。
works.comment_en: Brand Surge, a custom-merch e-commerce site: a client-project recap stacks long vertical page screenshots in violet and blue under "Promotional products that perform", with backpacks, caps and other branded goods taking turns on screen; one stack of screenshots and one performance promise lay out the whole pitch.
works.title: Client Project Recap - Brand Surge Website Design

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 生物科技移动端 ordivalabs：倾斜的手机屏配蓝色机械移液臂蓝图，“10x Higher Throughput、99.8% More Accuracy”两组数据镇场，粉色卡片一句“A healthier tomorrow, in motion”收尾；硬核实验设备用“一幅蓝图 + 两组数字”把精度讲得像科幻片。
works.comment_en: ordivalabs, a biotech mobile UI: a tilted phone screen pairs with a blue blueprint of a robotic pipetting arm, anchored by "10x Higher Throughput" and "99.8% More Accuracy", closing on a pink card that reads "A healthier tomorrow, in motion"; lab hardware reads like science fiction through one blueprint and two numbers.
works.title: ordivalabs: Automated Pipetting Systems - Biotech Mobile UI

works.author: Bato UI/UX
works.comment: 项目管理落地页：浅色页面左侧大标题配任务卡片，右侧仪表盘一眼看到项目进度与团队成员；SaaS 落地页用“一左一右两栏”把产品长什么样、管什么事同时交代清楚。
works.comment_en: A project-management landing page: a light layout pairs a big headline and task cards on the left with a dashboard of project progress and teammates on the right; one two-column split shows what the product looks like and what it manages, at the same time.
works.title: Project Management Landing Page

works.author: RonDesignLab
works.comment: 销售分析 App Luma：浅色多屏并排，“Sales Overview”曲线图打头，收入、订单与客户数据层层递进；销售数据 App 用“一组曲线 + 多屏递进”把业绩讲成一条向上的故事线。
works.comment_en: Luma, a sales-performance analytics app: light screens sit side by side, led by a "Sales Overview" curve and followed by revenue, orders and customer data; sales figures become an upward story through one chart and a sequence of screens.
works.title: Luma — Sales Performance Analytics Mobile App UI

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: B2B SaaS CRM 平台站：深色仪表盘里“Customers”波形图与“73% win rate”并排，橙色“Special Offer”横幅横贯页面，下方任务列表收尾；CRM 官网用“一幅波形图 + 一条橙色横幅”把赢单率做成视觉焦点。
works.comment_en: A B2B SaaS CRM platform site: a dark dashboard pairs a "Customers" waveform with a "73% win rate", cut across by an orange "Special Offer" banner above a task list; one waveform and one orange banner turn win rate into the visual focus.
works.title: B2B Website - SaaS CRM Platform

works.author: Afterglow
works.comment: SaaS 协作仪表盘 Sofia：浅色界面里“Team Performance Overview”、“Productivity Trend +17%”、“Recent Tasks”三块并排，右侧 Sofia AI 助手面板随时待命；协作工具用“三块数据 + 一个 AI 助手”把团队状态与下一步行动收在一屏。
works.comment_en: Sofia, a SaaS collaboration dashboard: a light interface lines up "Team Performance Overview", "Productivity Trend +17%" and "Recent Tasks", with a Sofia AI assistant panel standing by on the right; team status and next steps fit one screen through three data blocks and one AI helper.
works.title: UX/UI Design for Sofia - SaaS collaboration dashboard

works.author: Shakuro
works.comment: AI 运动员表现与恢复 App：黑色运动界面大字“TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR READINESS”，“EASY RUN”训练卡配心率 137 bpm、配速 5:35/km，两部手机并排展示跑步数据；运动 App 用“一句口号 + 两组身体数据”把“状态尽在掌握”做得很有力量感。
works.comment_en: An AI athlete performance and recovery app: a black sports interface headlines "TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR READINESS", with an "EASY RUN" card showing 137 bpm heart rate and a 5:35/km pace across two phones of running data; readiness feels tangible through one slogan and two body metrics.
works.title: AI Athlete Performance & Recovery Mobile App Design

works.author: Tony Romain
works.comment: 时尚电商数字画册 18 East：横向滚动的时装摄影大图配编辑排版，“HAND-SPUN, HAND-WOVEN”点出手工质感；时尚电商用“一组大图横滚 + 一句手工宣言”把衣服卖成一本杂志。
works.comment_en: 18 East, a digital lookbook: horizontally scrolling fashion photography in editorial layouts, with "HAND-SPUN, HAND-WOVEN" vouching for the handmade feel; fashion e-commerce sells clothes like a magazine through one scrolling gallery and one craft manifesto.
works.title: 18 East — Digital Lookbook Concept
